items.name: certbot
notes: Standalone mode needs port 80 reachable for the requested domain.

items.name: Cloudflare DNS
notes: Use DNS-only A records for raw TCP/UDP VPN ports unless the architecture is CDN-fronted HTTP/WebSocket/gRPC.
Never expose API tokens. Prefer zone-scoped DNS edit tokens.

items.name: VESSL

items.name: Abuse-Defender

items.name: OPIran VPS Optimizer
notes: Can modify sysctl/BBR, DNS, APT mirrors, kernel packages, hosts entries, swap, and reboot.
Use selected changes only after reading docs/networking-recipes.md.

items.name: dev-ir Ubuntu mirror selector
notes: Benchmarks mirrors and rewrites Ubuntu APT source URLs.
Pin the gist revision and back up sources before use.
